legends.clearance: green=sampled capsule/headroom clear, red=blocked; not proof of reachability
legends.collision: green collision wire meshes shown through occluders
legends.depth: linear camera depth, black=0 m white=30 m; background black
legends.intersections: green markers at sampled triangle crossings, shown through occluders; intentional contacts included
legends.limits: debug materials preserve flagstone clipping but not shader peeling/displacement/transparency; paired color view is authoritative
legends.normals: world normal XYZ mapped to RGB
legends.objects: stable per-object colors; see objects.json; each MultiMesh is one object
